mapper.select: SELECT FROM paid_coupon_reservation_batch WHERE request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paid_coupon_reservation_batch(request_id, user_id, items, state, expires_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{userId}, #{items}, 'RESERVED', #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE paid_coupon_reservation_batch SET state = 'CLAIMED' WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND state = 'RESERVED'
